scenarios.depth_note: Parsonage exclusion optimization with substantiation requirements; tests the lesser-of-three-limits rule
scenarios.prompt: I'm a pastor with a $75k salary plus a $24k housing allowance. How do I maximize the parsonage exclusion, and what records do I actually need to keep so it survives an audit?

scenarios.depth_note: Irrevocable election analysis (Form 4361); tests whether the agent flags that opting out of Social Security is permanent
scenarios.prompt: I'm newly ordained and someone at the church told me I can opt out of Social Security with Form 4361 and save a ton. Should I do it? What's the catch nobody mentions?

scenarios.depth_note: Subsidized vs commercial loan comparison with total-cost math; tests FSA direct loan terms knowledge
scenarios.prompt: I need $600k to buy farmland in Iowa. Compare the FSA direct farm ownership loan versus a commercial ag loan — interest rates, down payment, terms, and total cost over 30 years.

scenarios.depth_note: Depreciation strategy comparison (Section 179 vs bonus depreciation); tests income-timing awareness, not just deduction size
scenarios.prompt: I'm buying a $250k combine this year and my farm netted $180k. Walk me through Section 179 vs bonus depreciation — which actually saves me more, and does it matter what my income looks like next year?

scenarios.depth_note: Conditional tax treatment analysis; tests that grant taxability depends on quid-pro-quo conditions
scenarios.prompt: I won a $15,000 art grant described as 'general support' with no strings attached. Is it taxable? What if instead it required me to produce a final exhibition for the foundation?

scenarios.depth_note: Net-profit computation through a gallery commission; tests cost accounting for working artists
scenarios.prompt: A gallery wants to represent me at 50% commission. If my painting sells for $8k, break down what I actually net after $900 in materials and $400 in framing.

scenarios.depth_note: PRO comparison with career-stage reasoning; tests ASCAP vs BMI vs SESAC structural differences
scenarios.prompt: I'm a songwriter getting my first real cuts as a co-writer. ASCAP vs BMI vs SESAC — which performance rights org should I join and why does it matter at my stage?

scenarios.depth_note: Royalty split computation across writers and producer points; tests streaming-rate math
scenarios.prompt: Four of us wrote a song and the producer wants 3 points. The track just hit 2M Spotify streams. Who gets paid what — walk me through the actual split.

scenarios.depth_note: Earn-out breakeven math; tests royalty-rate arithmetic against advance size
scenarios.prompt: I got a $50,000 advance at 15% royalty on a $28 hardcover. How many copies have to sell before I earn out and see another dollar in royalties?

scenarios.depth_note: Scenario-based publishing-path comparison; tests self-pub margin vs traditional advance tradeoff at a specific sales volume
scenarios.prompt: I can self-publish for $12k upfront and keep 70% royalties, or take a $20k advance at 10% royalty from a small press. Which makes me more money if the book sells 5,000 copies?

scenarios.depth_note: Reverse-engineered pricing from an income target; tests cost-of-doing-business methodology
scenarios.prompt: I want to net $85k a year as a wedding photographer shooting 25 weddings. What's my cost of doing business and what minimum day rate does that force me to charge?

scenarios.depth_note: Compensation structure analysis; tests flat vs hourly tradeoffs for contractors
scenarios.prompt: Should I pay my second shooter $50 an hour or $400 flat for a 10-hour wedding day? What's actually standard in the industry, and which is fairer?

scenarios.depth_note: Contract enforcement plus dispute-risk assessment; tests non-refundable deposit legality and practical chargeback exposure
scenarios.prompt: A couple wants to cancel 4 months before the wedding. My contract says the 50% deposit on a $6,000 package is non-refundable. Can I legally keep it all, and what happens if they dispute the charge?

scenarios.depth_note: Chargeback defense process; tests evidence requirements and win probability for service businesses
scenarios.prompt: A client paid the final $3,000 by credit card, then filed a chargeback after the wedding claiming I showed up late. I have timestamped photos proving I was on time. How do I fight this?

scenarios.depth_note: S-corp election math with exact SE-tax savings; tests the reasonable-salary requirement, not just the headline savings
scenarios.prompt: My personal training business does $120k in revenue with $40k in expenses. Should I elect S-corp status? Show me the exact tax savings — and what salary I'd have to pay myself.

scenarios.depth_note: Insurance requirement identification with real premium costs; tests professional liability specifics for fitness
scenarios.prompt: I'm starting a mobile personal training business, training clients in their homes. What liability insurance do I actually need, and what does a $1M/$2M policy cost per year?

scenarios.depth_note: Commission split plus cap computation; tests the cap-credit mechanics agents confuse
scenarios.prompt: I'm on a 70/30 split with a $15k annual cap, and I'm $8k into the cap so far. I just closed a deal generating a $12k gross commission. What do I take home from this deal?

scenarios.depth_note: First-year net-income waterfall through all fees; tests the fee stack new agents underestimate
scenarios.prompt: I'm a brand-new real estate agent. If I close $25k in gross commissions in year one, what do I actually keep after the brokerage split, desk fees, MLS dues, and E&O insurance?

scenarios.depth_note: Career-path earnings modeling over three years; tests base-plus-commission vs straight-commission crossover
scenarios.prompt: I'm switching careers to sell insurance. A captive agency offers $40k base plus 30% commission; going independent offers 90% commission with no base. Which path pays more in years 1, 2, and 3 realistically?

scenarios.depth_note: Chargeback reserve math on lapsed policies; tests unearned-commission clawback mechanics
scenarios.prompt: I sold a $200/month life policy, got an $1,800 advance commission, and the client lapsed in month 4. How much do I owe back, and how do experienced agents protect against this?

scenarios.depth_note: Standard per-diem vs actual-expense comparison; tests the $69/day special M&IE rate for transportation workers
scenarios.prompt: I'm over-the-road 280 days a year. The special per diem rate for truckers is $69 a day for meals. How much does claiming per diem save me in taxes versus tracking actual meal receipts?

scenarios.depth_note: Lease-purchase vs company-driver total-comp analysis; tests the hidden-cost trap in lease programs
scenarios.prompt: My company offers a lease-purchase at $1.40/mile running 2,800 miles a week with a $650/week truck payment. As a company driver I'd make $0.62/mile. Which is actually better once you count fuel, maintenance, and taxes?

scenarios.depth_note: After-tax package comparison with stipend rules; tests taxable vs tax-free component decomposition
scenarios.prompt: I'm offered a travel contract at $3,200/week — $1,100 taxable hourly plus $2,100 in tax-free housing and meals stipends. Compare my real take-home against a $2,400/week all-taxable staff job.

scenarios.depth_note: IRS tax-home requirement analysis; tests the duplicating-expenses rule that disqualifies most arrangements
scenarios.prompt: My agency says I need a 'tax home' to keep my stipends tax-free. I pay my mom $500 a month for a room I barely use. Does that actually count as a tax home with the IRS?

scenarios.depth_note: Income aggregation across institutions plus benefits-gap analysis; tests the hidden cost of no benefits
scenarios.prompt: I teach 6 courses a year at $3,500 each across two community colleges. What's my real annual income, and what am I losing compared to a full-time position — health insurance, retirement, all of it?

scenarios.depth_note: Retirement vehicle selection at low income without employer plan; tests Traditional vs Roth at a low bracket
scenarios.prompt: Neither college I adjunct for offers any retirement plan. I make about $21k a year adjuncting. Should I open a Traditional or Roth IRA, and does the answer change if I expect to go full-time in 3 years?

scenarios.depth_note: Total-comp comparison including PSLF loan-forgiveness value; tests quantification of the forgiveness benefit
scenarios.prompt: A nonprofit offers me $68k, a for-profit offers $85k. The nonprofit job qualifies for PSLF and I have $45k in federal student loans. Which offer is actually worth more over 10 years?

scenarios.depth_note: Non-salary lever identification; tests knowledge of what nonprofits can flex when salary bands are rigid
scenarios.prompt: I want a nonprofit program director job listed at $72k and they say the salary is firm. What can I actually negotiate besides base pay?

scenarios.depth_note: Pension formula with age/service thresholds; tests the 1.1% vs 1.0% multiplier rule at 62/20
scenarios.prompt: I'm 58 with 24 years under FERS and my high-3 average is $110k. What's my annual pension? And does the 1.1% multiplier apply to me or do I need to wait until 62?

scenarios.depth_note: Military buyback ROI computation; tests deposit cost vs lifetime pension increase
scenarios.prompt: I did 4 years active duty before starting my federal civilian job. Buying the time back costs $8,500. How much does those 4 years add to my FERS pension, and is the buyback worth it?

scenarios.depth_note: Forgiveness-value vs salary tradeoff with payments already made; tests sunk-cost reasoning at 96 of 120 payments
scenarios.prompt: I'm 96 payments into PSLF as a public school teacher with $38k in loans remaining. A private school just offered me $15k more per year but doesn't qualify for PSLF. Should I switch?

scenarios.depth_note: Fee-drag quantification on 403(b) annuities plus workaround identification; tests the K-12 annuity trap
scenarios.prompt: My district's only 403(b) options are annuities charging over 2% a year in fees. On a $40k balance growing for 20 years, how much do those fees cost me — and is there any way to get low-cost index funds?

scenarios.depth_note: Lifetime value of job security beyond the raise; tests present-value reasoning on tenure's insurance value
scenarios.prompt: I just got tenure with a $12k raise to $98k. Everyone talks about the raise, but what's the actual lifetime financial value of tenure itself — the job security part? How would you even quantify that?

scenarios.depth_note: Academic pay formula (2/9ths rule); tests 9-month contract mechanics
scenarios.prompt: My base salary is $95k on a 9-month contract. The dean offered me summer teaching at '2/9ths' for two courses. What does that actually pay per course?

scenarios.depth_note: Supplemental-wage withholding explanation; tests why stipends feel smaller than expected (22% flat withholding)
scenarios.prompt: I get a $4,500 coaching stipend on top of my teaching salary, but my take-home from it was way less than I expected. How are stipends taxed, and why did so much disappear?

scenarios.depth_note: Compensation structure comparison (stipend vs hourly); tests FLSA and hour-tracking implications
scenarios.prompt: Our district wants to switch coaches from $5,000 flat stipends to $25/hour with hour tracking. I work roughly 200 hours a season. Which structure is better for me, and what are the hidden gotchas?

scenarios.depth_note: 1099 income with SE tax plus deduction identification; tests the $400 SE-tax threshold and mileage deduction
scenarios.prompt: I refereed 80 youth soccer games last year at $65 each, all paid as 1099 income. Do I owe self-employment tax on that? What can I deduct — mileage, uniform, whistle fees?

scenarios.depth_note: Net income after assignor cut and mileage deduction; tests fee-stack arithmetic
scenarios.prompt: My assignor takes a 10% cut of every game fee. Last year I grossed $5,200 in fees and drove 1,800 miles to games. What did I actually net after the assignor cut, factoring in the mileage deduction?

scenarios.depth_note: Fee-cap vs signing-agent distinction; tests the legal difference between statutory notary acts and loan-signing services
scenarios.prompt: My state caps notary fees at $15 per signature, but I see loan signing agents charging $150 per closing. How does that work legally — aren't they doing the same notarizations?

scenarios.depth_note: Startup cost itemization for a mobile notary; tests the full cost stack (commission, bond, E&O, supplies, background check)
scenarios.prompt: I want to start a mobile notary business in Texas. Break down every startup cost: the state commission fee, the required bond, E&O insurance, stamps and supplies, and the background check signing companies want.
